profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary:
- R&D on low level performance optimizations.
- Strong debugging ability, even when lacking logging or stacktrace.
- Proven adaptability in ambiguous environment. Comfortable diving into very large codebase in a short amount of time.

Specialties: GPU, SIMD programming, Low level programming, 3D Maths and linear algebra.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Tech Lead for Meta Quest's GPU profiling stack (OS + API + tooling integration).
	Development and maintenance of Quest’s GPU profiling daemon.
	Integrated with Perfetto for system level analysis.
	Integrated with RenderDoc for repeatable performance experiments.
	Managed integration, communications and requests for the Qualcomm Partnership.
	Forked and evolved RenderDoc Meta Fork into AR/VR’s most critical GPU debugger and profiler.
	Improved quality via automation and telemetry methods. Reduced launch failures by 85% and disconnections by 84%.
	Migrated and debugged Qt’s Shiboken (CPython C-API bindings) for the Python embedded interpreter. Built and upgraded the Python library to allow MPC plugin on Mac.
	Spearheaded the development of multi-platform telemetry library with org wide adoption. Designed high-performance APIs for telemetry submission. Work included a suite of automated tests that pass continuous runs in ASAN and TSAN mode.
	Contribution to Meta’s core system utility libraries such as Folly.
	Managed product roadmap for 3-engineer team with full stack ownership (CI/CD, dashboards, and automation infrastructure)
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · RenderDoc · C++ · Android Development · Android · Android SDK · Android NDK · Android Open Source Project · Vulkan API · OpenGL · Automation · Performance Optimization · Python (Programming Language) · HACK · Mercurial · Git · AOSP

positions.title: Rendering Engineer
positions.description:
	Performance profiling/optimization for various platforms.
	R&D on various graphics techniques (subtractive mesh/order independent transparency).
	Handled various GPU related bugs (d3d errors/gl errors/gpu timeouts/ps4 gpu fence problem).
	Developed various systems based on inputs from designer and artists (ui post effects/post effect particles/)
	Research, verify and correct existing algorithm/math equation for higher visual quality and performance (software occlusion buffer system of cryengine/normal map baking using xnormal).
     Added a GearVR profiling feature to RenderDoc.

positions.title: Technology/Graphics Programmer
positions.description:
- R&D of SIMD visibility checks that allowed frustum (6 planes) vs. 15000 AABB checks
     *0.14 milliseconds for Intel Core 2 Quad.
     *0.22 milliseconds for XBOX360 (3.2GHz POWERPC)

- R&D of Access Aligned Sort (by IBM Tokyo Research Lab) for runtime sorting.
     *Sorts 15000 32bit integer key + 32bit data in 0.72 ms for Intel Xeon W5580.
     *1.10 milliseconds for XBOX360 (3.2GHz POWERPC).

- Fast SIMD Level of Detail calculation system.

- R&D of a proprietary PVS(Potential Visible Set) system.

- R&D of a novel Occlusion Culling technique to replace PVS.

- Data Oriented re-design of the runtime rendering pipeline (memory optimization).

- DX9/DX11 multithreading maintenance.

- Maintain and support POWERPC, x86, x64.

positions.title: Associate Gameplay Programmer
positions.description:
Procedural Physics, Weapon Physics.

Third-Person Camera System, Third-Person Weapon System.

Character Animation for Weapon hit reactions.

GamePlay Inventory system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Asset building (using Ruby) and loading.

Shader and Deformable Model setup (Cloth).

Camera Manipulation.
